answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 6095 Country: Canada Title: We live in North America(canada) and if any of our non muslim colleague died then how to condolence islamically. Mean to say as a member of your office team how to participate. Please reply in detail. Question: We live in North America(canada) and if any of our non muslim colleague died then how to condolence islamically. Mean to say as a member of your office team how to participate. Please reply in detail. Thanks Answer ID: 6095 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 988/933=D/1429) There is no harm in pronouncing a few words of condolence for solace and soothe. There is no objection in remembering any characteristic of the deceased i.e. human sympathy and moral goodness. However, it is not permitted to join the non-Islamic funeral customs and religious rituals non-Muslims. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
